'''April 2000 Helmond tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Helmond, Netherlands on 16 April 2000. [[Patrick Monsigneur]] won it. It is known from Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d549">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000d549/ netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000d549/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Helmond, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 32
* '''Winner:''' [[Patrick Monsigneur]]
